title: Immigration Enriches Our Economy
narrative: Immigrants are stealing our jobs and draining public resources
summary: Studies show immigrants create jobs through entrepreneurship and fill critical labor gaps. They contribute more in taxes than they receive in benefits, with net positive economic impact.

title: Climate Action Creates Jobs
narrative: Climate policies will destroy the economy and eliminate jobs
summary: The renewable energy sector is creating more jobs than fossil fuels. Green transitions have historically led to net job growth with proper planning and worker retraining programs.

title: Diverse Teams Drive Innovation
narrative: Diversity quotas lower standards and harm meritocracy
summary: Research demonstrates diverse teams outperform homogeneous ones in problem-solving and innovation. Companies with diverse leadership show better financial performance.
